metadata.title: Clicked like a confused potato and somehow doubled their uninstall timer?! Valorant aim is broken
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I pressed the wrong button twice
Enemy: probably reconsidering their life choices
How did that 2-for-1 even happen? No clue but I’m not arguing
If your aim’s a lovable disaster, this is your jam

Tap if your aim ever does this magic trick mid-game
